title: Payment, Returned-Payment and Renewal Timing Figures — Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
Payment and renewal timing figures of Rental Property Service Contracts, all counted in calendar days, with the returned-payment fee in dollars.

| Tier | Payment grace after an installment's due date | Cure period after suspension | Returned-payment fee | Renewal notice lead before term end | Late-renewal grace after term end |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Appliance | 30 days | 30 days | $25.00 | 45 days | 30 days |
| Bridgewell Rental Systems | 30 days | 30 days | $25.00 | 45 days | 30 days |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo | 30 days | 30 days | $25.00 | 45 days | 30 days |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus | 30 days | 30 days | $25.00 | 45 days | 30 days |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo | 30 days | 30 days | $25.00 | 45 days | 30 days |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus | 30 days | 30 days | $25.00 | 45 days | 30 days |

## What each column measures

- **Payment grace:** calendar days after an installment's due date before nonpayment suspends service.
- **Cure period:** calendar days after suspension during which paying the full past-due balance reinstates the contract.
- **Returned-payment fee:** the fee billed when a premium payment is returned unpaid.
- **Renewal notice lead:** the minimum calendar days before term end by which the renewal notice must be issued for automatic renewal.
- **Late-renewal grace:** calendar days after term end during which an expired contract can be renewed without a new waiting period.

The figures are the same on all six tiers.
